title: THE SCUMM STICK · OPEN box
venue: private · after the machine in the pizza window · Box 32
logline: The garage again, the wall of boxes, one outlined — the last one — and the sentence line OPEN box, and beneath the verb bar the engine's answer drawn as a small balloon from nowhere: a blank line. The page draws the response the machine gives when a thing can't be opened yet. The box isn't numbered on this page.
